reason: We have already decided on the new market and trade fairs alone will not fill the pipeline in six months, so a free list of 15 targets and a pilot capped at EUR 900 that I can sign off myself is a low-risk way to see if this works. I would take Step 1 first and only start the pilot if the targets and the local-language message look like they came from someone who knows our industry.
objection: Our name is what we sell on. If emails go out from some other domain, in a tone that reads like spam to a German or Romanian buyer, or a prospect complains about GDPR, I have damaged the market before we even enter it, and the EUR 900 cap does not cover that. One logistics client with 45 meetings is not much proof for a manufacturer.
